user.title: Smart Energy Cost & Meter
user.description: Configure your smart energy cost and consumption tracking.

data_description.energy_sensor: Select a continuous, steadily increasing energy sensor in kWh.
data_description.price_sensor: Optional. If set, dynamic prices take precedence. The fixed price then serves as a fallback.
data_description.monthly_fee: Enter your monthly fixed base fee here.
data_description.fee_time: Enter the daily time at which your base fee is added proportionally.
